Aiden Oneill.note: O'Neill's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Aiden Oneill.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Ajdin Hrustic.note: Hrustić's edge is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Ajdin Hrustic.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Alessandro Circati.note: Circati's signature is keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Alessandro Circati.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Awer Mabil.note: Mabil's edge is explosive speed once open grass appears. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Awer Mabil.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Aziz Behich.note: Watch Behich for calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Aziz Behich.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Cameron Burgess.note: Burgess's edge is reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Cameron Burgess.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Cameron Devlin.summary: Cammy Devlin is an Australia central midfielder from Heart of Midlothian who gives the national team ball-winning bite, pressing range, and combative energy.
Cameron Devlin.note: Devlin's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Cameron Devlin.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Christian Volpato.note: Volpato is defined by changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Christian Volpato.noteZh: 他靠变向时仍把球控制在脚下与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Connor Metcalfe.note: Metcalfe's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Connor Metcalfe.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Harry Souttar.note: Souttar is defined by reading the flight of the ball before the duel begins. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Harry Souttar.noteZh: 他靠在争顶前先判断球的飞行轨迹与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Jackson Irvine.note: Watch Irvine for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Jackson Irvine.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在危险出现前组织好队友。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Jacob Italiano.note: Italiano is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Jacob Italiano.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Jason Geria.note: Geria stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Jason Geria.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Jordan Bos.note: Bos's signature is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Jordan Bos.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在防线暴露后的回追速度上。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Kai Trewin.note: Trewin is defined by moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Kai Trewin.noteZh: 他靠用传球的力度和角度移动防线与同位置球员拉开差异。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Lucas Herrington.note: Watch Herrington for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Lucas Herrington.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Mathew Leckie.note: Leckie's signature is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap.
Mathew Leckie.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断上。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。

Mathew Ryan.note: Ryan's edge is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Mathew Ryan.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Milos Degenek.note: Degenek is defined by the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Milos Degenek.noteZh: 他靠在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构与同位置球员拉开差异。他会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Mohamed Toure.summary: Mohamed Touré is an Australia centre-forward from Norwich City who gives the national team pace, penalty-box finishing, and direct channel runs.
Mohamed Toure.note: Touré stands out for explosive speed once open grass appears. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Mohamed Toure.noteZh: 他的突出特点是看到空当后的爆发速度。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Nestory Irankunda.note: Irankunda is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Nestory Irankunda.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Nishan Velupillay.note: Velupillay is defined by explosive speed once open grass appears. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Nishan Velupillay.noteZh: 他靠看到空当后的爆发速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Patrick Beach.note: Beach's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Patrick Beach.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Paul Izzo.note: Izzo stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He keeps his decisions calm when a sudden save is required. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Paul Izzo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会突然需要扑救时仍能冷静判断。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Paul Okon-Engstler.note: Okon-Engstler is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Paul Okon-Engstler.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Tete Yengi.note: Watch Yengi for using strength without slowing the next action. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Tete Yengi.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。
